p2.title: Add real session continuity and epoch reset coverage
p2.body: Current tests cover the selector and artifact synchronization, but not consecutive real evaluate calls, refresh-epoch reset through the session, or the uncapped/no-op transition-cap path.

p2.title: Expose final selected roles more explicitly
p2.body: The role_rank_buffer diagnostics are persisted and synchronized, but do not separately expose a final selected_roles field or role-buffer artifact.

p3.title: Existing pytest cache ACL warning
p3.body: Pytest emitted the pre-existing PytestCacheWarning because the workspace pytest cache is not writable.

findings_summary: No new P0/P1; both previous P1 findings addressed. R87 is approved for the single required paired backtest, subject to the campaign Champion gate.
